title: onedevR — R client for the OneDev REST API
text: Issue / build / PR numbers UI numbers, internal IDs. OneDev #145 (see UI) different value internal REST id. high-level API always takes UI number; see §9 plan / tod ref formats. Resolution tries projectPath#n, bare #n / n OneDev versions reject path-prefixed numbers. OneDev endpoints accept one payload shape depending version/installation (e.g. issue creation, state transitions, iterations). onedevr tries known variants rather picking one failing silently others — see §10 plan. Custom issue fields installation-specific. ’s fixed schema; fields treated named list. Connections: pass conn = od_connection(...) per call, od_set_connection(conn) package default. Env vars remain fallback. Bearer token default; Basic Auth via username/password (ONEDEV_USERNAME / ONEDEV_PASSWORD). List queries return tibbles default (od_query_issues(), etc.). Use as_tibble = FALSE options(onedevr.as_tibble = FALSE) raw lists. Single-object getters stay lists.

code: .od_prepare_request <- function(method, url, token, insecure_ssl = FALSE) {   req <- httr2::request(url)   req <- httr2::req_method(req, method)   req <- httr2::req_headers(     req,     Authorization = paste("Bearer", token),     Accept = "application/json"   )   req <- httr2::req_timeout(req, 30)   req <- httr2::req_error(req, is_error = function(resp) FALSE)    if (isTRUE(insecure_ssl)) {     req <- httr2::req_options(req, ssl_verifypeer = 0L, ssl_verifyhost = 0L)   }    req }

code: od_request <- function(method = "GET", endpoint, query = NULL, body = NULL, conn = NULL) {   conn <- conn %||% od_get_config()   method <- toupper(trimws(as.character(method)[1]))   url <- .od_resolve_api_url(endpoint, conn)   req <- .od_prepare_request(method, url, conn$token, conn$insecure_ssl)    if (length(query) > 0) {     query <- query[!vapply(query, is.null, logical(1))]     if (length(query) > 0) {       req <- do.call(httr2::req_url_query, c(list(req), query))     }   }    if (!is.null(body)) {     json_body <- jsonlite::toJSON(body, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null")     req <- httr2::req_headers(req, "Content-Type" = "application/json")     req <- httr2::req_body_raw(req, as.character(json_body))   }    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)   payload <- .od_parse_response_body(response)   if (httr2::resp_status(response) >= 400L) {     .od_http_error(response, payload)   }    payload }
